passages.quote: As is normal ahead of an election, this guidance is for civil servants in UK Government departments and for those arms length bodies on the principles that they should observe in relation to the conduct of Government business, in the run up to the forthcoming elections to the Northern Ireland Assembly on 2 March 2017.
